verdict.rationale: MX documents a public Platform API with an official OpenAPI specification, published on GitHub and downloadable for Postman import. Free developer API keys with key rotation, test institutions, webhooks and machine-readable docs (llms.txt) round out programmatic access. The 404s at guessed OpenAPI paths do not contradict this, since the spec is published elsewhere. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product end-to-end via the API.
